  - text: Uses the built-in OpenHands instructions for coding, security and tool use. Model Router
  - group:
    - combobox "Show suggestions": "Off"
    - button "Show suggestions"
  - text: With a router selected, this agent can route each task to one of your LLM profiles. Routers are managed on the Model Router page. Parallel tool calls Optional
  - spinbutton "Parallel tool calls Optional": "1"
  - paragraph: Maximum number of tool calls the agent runs at the same time in one step. 1 runs them one after another (default). Higher values run tool calls in parallel; they share the conversation, files and working directory, so changes to shared state can conflict.
  - text: Tools
  - group:
    - combobox "Show suggestions": Standard tools
    - button "Show suggestions"
  - list:
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "file_editor" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: file_editor View, create and edit files.
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "task_tracker" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: task_tracker Keep a running task list to organise multi-step work.
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "terminal" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: terminal Run shell commands in a persistent terminal session.
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "browser_tool_set" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: "browser_tool_set Browse the web: navigate pages, click, type and read content."
    - listitem:
      - checkbox "switch_llm" [checked] [disabled]
      - text: switch_llm Let the agent switch the conversation to another saved LLM profile.
  - text: This agent gets the tools the server considers standard, shown above. The list follows the server, so it can change when the server is upgraded. MCP servers
  - group:
    - combobox "Show suggestions": All servers
    - button "Show suggestions"
  - text: You have not configured any MCP servers yet. This agent can use every MCP server you have configured, including any that can make changes. Condenser
